calls.title: Philip Presentation
calls.summary: The discussion illuminated GrowthBook's core value in feature flagging and validation, essential for supporting AI-driven software development. The shift toward probabilistic AI outputs necessitates meticulous metrics and experimentation tools, positioning GrowthBook as a significant player in the evolving AI software ecosystem. The content strategy aims to create evergreen educational resources alongside practical examples to engage the developer community. Proposed metrics will link content effectiveness to user signups and enhance developer retention. The initial 90-day action plan emphasizes improving onboarding experiences and fostering community feedback for better documentation and content output, while a focus on video content and influencer collaborations is anticipated for broader outreach.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Feature Flags, DevRel Metrics, AI/Agentic Experience, Content Strategy, Developer Onboarding
calls.action_items:

Conduct agentic experience audit of Growth Book documentation, submit improvements as PRs, and track related metrics (32:00)

Establish and nurture cross-functional relationships with engineering, product, support, and marketing teams to build trust and collaboration (28:21)
Set up community feedback mechanisms, ensuring timely response to Slack queries and GitHub issues/PRs (35:50)
Develop and implement a content cadence aiming for weekly content publication, with ongoing metric-based iteration (37:40)
Explore improvements for MCP server including error recovery processes and agent self-onboarding capabilities (46:45)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Monitor and provide feedback on Philip’s onboarding progress and initial deliverables (30:45)
Coordinate next steps and debrief communication post presentation with candidates (48:51)

**Hiring Team**
Conduct reference checks and compensation discussions with preferred candidate Riley (57:10)
Evaluate performance and impact of community and content programs through metrics to prioritize channels effectively (37:49)
